name: XLE_CONTACT_LEGAL_ROLES
description: XLE_CONTACT_LEGAL_ROLES contains the legal roles that a contact can have.

columns.name: CONTACT_ROLE_ID
columns.description: Contact role identifier. Primary key generated from sequence.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Contact party identifier. Foreign key from HZ_PARTIES for the contact person.

columns.name: LE_ETB_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity or establishment party identifier. Foreign key from HZ_PARTIES for the legal entity or establishment.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Source table name for the information, either XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES or XLE_ETB_PROFILES.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Source identifier, identifier for the registered legal entity or establishment.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup type for the data being stored in this table. The lookup type is XLE_CONTACT_ROLE.

columns.name: LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Legal role name. Lookup code from lookup type XLE_CONTACT_ROLE.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Date on which a task, event or business process begins. Use for date enabled entities for which histories are not stored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Date that a task, event, or business process ends. Use for date enabled entities that histories are not stored for.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
